images.caption: Front and western side of the Laurence Cable House, located at 910 W. Monroe Street in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1878, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: Laurence Cable House, a 19th-century lake-town house. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Laurence Cable House (Sandusky, 1870s-80s): a limestone Gothic Revival house with steep slate cross gables trimmed with bracketed bargeboards, tall paired windows; behind an overgrown hedge; a recycling bin
